description_zh: 安东尼奥·德·奥利韦拉·德·卡尔瓦略·一世公爵/萨拉查/新国家政权/独裁统治/中立政策/非洲殖民战争/康乃馨革命
description_en: António de Oliveira Salazar established the New State (Estado Novo) dictatorship in Portugal (1932-1968), maintaining neutrality during WWII, overseeing African colonial wars, and leading the Carnation Revolution in 1974 that ended his regime and began decolonization.
